scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path lambda-package) { Remove-Item lambda-package -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path lambda.zip) { Remove-Item lambda.zip -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory lambda-package | Out-Null; Copy-Item dist\* lambda-package\ -Recurse; Copy-Item package.json lambda-package\; Copy-Item package-lock.json lambda-package\; Copy-Item node_modules lambda-package\ -Recurse; Compress-Archive -Path lambda-package\* -DestinationPath lambda.zip -Force"
